title: Category-theoretic foundations
summary: Category-theoretic foundations emphasize objects, composable arrows, and invariance under structure-preserving equivalence.

content.plain: Category-theoretic foundations emphasize objects, composable arrows, and invariance under structure-preserving equivalence.
content.exact: A category has objects, hom-sets or hom-types, associative composition, and identity arrows; foundational programs add size and logical structure in different ways.
content.example: Sets and functions form a category; groups and homomorphisms form another.
content.caveat: Category theory is not literally derivable from ‘arrows alone’ without a surrounding formal language or metatheory.
